options.name: auth
options.question: How do people sign in?
options.description: Authentication. Every choice except 'none' needs a database, and turns PostgreSQL on when --db is none.

choices.description: Accounts in your database with ASP.NET Core Identity: passwords, bearer tokens or cookies, MFA, passkeys.
Everything in 'identity', plus sign-in with Google, Apple and Microsoft.
Accounts in a hosted OpenID Connect provider such as Keycloak or Entra ID; the API validates its access tokens.

options.name: db
options.question: Which database?
options.description: Database, through EF Core with migrations, audit history and a compose deployment.

choices.description: No database; notes are kept in memory.
SQL Server 2022 through Microsoft.Data.SqlClient, with Testcontainers. Runs on amd64 only.
SQLite in a file next to the app: one machine, light write load.

options.name: email
options.question: Does the API send email?
options.description: Email delivery. 'smtp' adds an email transport (SMTP with MailKit, or the log in development) and templated messages.

choices.description: SMTP through MailKit, with a log transport for development.

options.name: jobs
options.question: Background jobs?
options.description: Background jobs. 'hangfire' needs a database, and turns PostgreSQL on when --db is none.

choices.description: No job framework; only the scoped background loop for housekeeping.
In-process queue and cron schedules on hosted services. Queued jobs are lost on restart.
Hangfire: durable queued and scheduled jobs in your database, retries, a dashboard.

options.name: worker
options.question: Run the jobs in a separate worker process?
options.description: Add a worker project that runs the API's jobs in its own process and container. Implies --jobs hangfire.

options.name: aspire
options.question: Add a .NET Aspire AppHost for local development?
options.description: Add a .NET Aspire AppHost that starts the API, the worker and the database for local development.

options.name: agents
options.question: Guidance files for AI coding agents?
options.description: Guidance files for AI coding agents.

choices.description: AGENTS.md, read by most coding agents.
AGENTS.md plus a CLAUDE.md that imports it.

rules.reason: Every sign-in mode stores users' data in a database.
Hangfire stores its jobs in the database.
The worker runs the API's Hangfire jobs in its own process.
